response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer (~14 years) with strong distributed-systems, low-latency, event-driven and full-stack credentials, but the role's core requirement — deep, current C++/STL expertise — is essentially absent from his profile. His only professional C++ exposure was a six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014/2015 and a university thesis project; his last decade is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang. He also shows no evidence of industrial automation domain knowledge, IEC 62443/SDL secure engineering practices, MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA protocols, or Azure. The transferable skills (multi-threading, message-driven architectures, high-throughput services, mentoring/teaching) are real, but the gap to a senior hands-on C++ industrial-cybersecurity role is too large to close quickly.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, event-driven, low-latency distributed systems
Broad full-stack range plus proven mentoring, workshops, and technical communication
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source ownership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and over a decade out of date
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA), or IEC 62443/SDL background
No evidence of Azure, secure coding standards, or UML/architecture documentation practice

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation & IEC 62443 security domain gap
